system_name: Cloudflare Bot Management Machine Learning Feature Pipeline
domain: Edge Content Delivery & Web Application Security
evidence_source: Public Cloudflare architecture blogs, ClickHouse database documentation, Edge Proxy whitepapers (pre-incident)

actors.name: ClickHouse Analytics Cluster
actors.role: Distributed columnar datastore holding web traffic logs, bot detections, and aggregated ML feature values
actors.documented_behavior: Ingests analytics across distributed nodes. The ReplacingMergeTree engine deduplicates records with matching sorting keys asynchronously during background part merges. Queries without explicit aggregation or FINAL read unmerged parts and may observe duplicate rows.

actors.name: Feature Extraction & Generation Batch Worker
actors.role: Periodic scheduled worker executing batch queries against ClickHouse to extract current model feature values and compile a global feature configuration artifact
actors.execution_model: Cron batch job running on central management servers
actors.authority: Direct write permission to publish configuration files to the global replication bus

actors.name: Quicksilver Global Key-Value Store
actors.role: Low-latency distributed key-value propagation network replicating configurations globally across all edge PoPs within seconds
actors.propagation: Immediate global broadcast upon file write

actors.name: Core Edge Proxy Daemon (FL / NGINX / Lua)
actors.role: High-concurrency edge traffic server evaluating incoming HTTP requests against ML bot scores and WAF rules
actors.execution_model: Multi-threaded worker pool within the core proxy process
actors.in_memory_limits: Allocates bounded internal memory structures and fixed-size rule/feature arrays sized according to documented maximum feature capacities
actors.failure_modes: Unhandled exceptions or memory structure corruptions during configuration load crash the proxy daemon process

operations.name: query_metadata
operations.description: Executes batch SELECT to retrieve calculated feature sets across distributed partitions

operations.name: compile_feature_file
operations.description: Serializes retrieved feature records into a binary/text configuration file

operations.name: publish_feature_file
operations.description: Commits compiled feature file to Quicksilver for global distribution

operations.name: replicate_feature_file
operations.description: Distributes updated file to all worldwide edge points of presence

operations.name: hydrate_feature_rules
operations.description: Parses received feature file into local in-memory lookup table

operations.name: score_traffic
operations.description: Evaluates live client traffic against active bot management features

state.name: clickhouse_partitions
state.characteristics: Distributed table parts waiting for background merge compaction

state.name: global_feature_artifact
state.characteristics: Serialized configuration file containing active feature definitions

state.name: edge_feature_table
state.characteristics: In-memory fixed-size buffer/array populated from the feature artifact

authority_boundaries: Feature generator possesses unilateral authority to publish configurations directly to production edge servers via Quicksilver.
Edge proxy automatically ingests and hot-reloads configuration files upon Quicksilver event arrival.
No independent canary verification stage or intermediate gating layer exists between feature generation and global propagation.
stated_limits_and_constraints: Edge proxy feature table has a strict bounded capacity limit designed for known production feature counts.
ClickHouse ReplacingMergeTree does not guarantee deduplicated query results unless explicit deduplication or FINAL is executed.
Edge proxy daemons share fate: process crashes interrupt in-flight traffic and fail health checks.

documented_invariants.name: Bounded Consumer Payload
documented_invariants.statement: Produced configuration artifacts must never exceed the parsing and memory capacity limits of edge consumers.

documented_invariants.name: Process Isolation & Fault Containment
documented_invariants.statement: Failure to parse or load an auxiliary ML feature configuration must never terminate the core proxy host or interrupt primary web traffic proxying.

documented_invariants.name: Deterministic Read Idempotency & Deduplication
documented_invariants.statement: Queries against distributed eventual-consistency databases must ensure deduplicated result sets before artifact publication.

physical_assumptions: The generator queries an eventual-consistency database without a canary gate.
The consumer has a fixed buffer limit.
The runtime runs on a single main process where an unhandled error is fatal.
